name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: "The top and bottom bars of a phone screen: navigation, a title, a search field and actions over the content. Desktop layouts have their own composition, so a toolbar never renders from 768px up."
docs: Import as `import { Toolbar, ToolbarLeading, ToolbarTitle, ToolbarTrailing } from '@/components/ui/toolbar'`. See https://plexui.com/vue/components/toolbar for props and examples.
